key_interactions.drug_or_class: Strong CYP3A4 inhibitors (ketoconazole, itraconazole, ritonavir, nefazodone)
key_interactions.action: Reduce the quetiapine dose to one sixth.
Doses up to 5-fold higher may be needed; reduce again within 7 to 14 days of stopping the inducer.
